rfq.text: SYNTHETIC acceptance case: no real transaction. Buy 120 food-grade pump seals, model PS-6. Budget: USD 800 including delivery to Durban, excluding import duties. Required receipt date: 2026-12-05. No purchase order or deposit has been issued. Please distinguish production, dispatch and actual receipt dates.

quotes.title: Quotation A
quotes.text: SYNTHETIC supplier Zinc Orange, model PS-6, quantity 120. Unit price USD 5.80; goods USD 696; packing USD 24; subtotal USD 720. Freight to Durban is excluded and not yet priced. Production takes 10 calendar days after a 40% deposit clears. Transit time and destination receipt date are not committed.
